title: LOW HEALTH FILTER: THE WORLD MUFFLES AS YOU BLEED
why: His yes on pick 70. Below 30 health the world mix runs through a soft low-pass that closes from about 12 kHz to 2.2 kHz as health falls to 0 (nothing at 30). It uses the same filter as the downed dip and waits out the dip, so they never stack, and menu sounds and stings never pass through it.
now: Below 30 health the sound of the world goes duller as you get worse. Back above 30 it opens again. Menu clicks and pickups stay crisp.
